name: VMM — Bulk Close Cases with Closure Email

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.id AS complaintid,
  cl.reasonfordelay,
  cl.subreasonfordelay
FROM vmm_complaints c
LEFT JOIN vmm_complaintlogs cl ON cl.complaintid = c.id
WHERE c.complaintno = '{{ $json["Complaint No"] }}'
ORDER BY cl.id DESC
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO vmm_complaintlogs (
  complaintid, status, currentstatus, fupdonevia, subject,
  closureinformdate, reasonfordelay, subreasonfordelay,
  caseclosedby, remarks, uid, created, updated, is_deleted
)
SELECT 
  {{ $('BulkClose Fetch Complaint').first().json.complaintid }},
  'Closed', 1, 'E-mail',
  '{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json["Email Subject"] }}',
  CURDATE(),
  '{{ $('BulkClose Fetch Complaint').first().json.reasonfordelay }}',
  '{{ $('BulkClose Fetch Complaint').first().json.subreasonfordelay }}',
  '{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json["Case Closed By"] }}',
  '{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json["Remarks"] }}',
  48, NOW(), NOW(), 'No'
FROM DUAL
WHERE (
  SELECT status FROM vmm_complaintlogs 
  WHERE complaintid = {{ $('BulkClose Fetch Complaint').first().json.complaintid }}
  ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
) != 'Closed';

SELECT c.complaintno, c.productname, c.typeofcomplaint, cs.storename, cs.storecode, cs.storeemail, cs.fmemail, cs.fmname FROM vmm_complaints c JOIN vmm_complaintstores cs ON cs.id = c.storerefid WHERE c.id = {{ $('BulkClose Fetch Complaint').first().json.complaintid }} LIMIT 1

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('Get row(s) in sheet').all(); let rowsHtml = rows.map(r => ` ${r.json['Complaint No']} ${r.json['Email Subject']} ${r.json['Case Closed By']} ${r.json['Remarks']} `).join(''); const html = `

The following complaints were closed:

${rowsHtml}
Complaint NoEmail SubjectCase Closed ByRemarks

Total closed: ${rows.length}

`; return [{ json: { emailHtml: html, count: rows.length } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'success', count: $('Build Email Summary').first().json.count, message: $('Build Email Summary').first().json.count + ' case(s) closed successfully' } }}
